sections.headingText: # Director of Enterprise Engineering — Nexus Cloud Systems

sections.rawContent: Nexus Cloud Systems provides high-throughput data integration infrastructure for banking and financial services.

- Lead and mentor an agile engineering pod of 8 senior developers and architects based in Bengaluru.
- Drive engineering excellence, code review standards, and CI/CD deployment reliability.
- Strategic target: scale the engineering organization to 50+ engineers over the next 3 years as the product suite expands internationally.
- Manage infrastructure spend across AWS and Google Cloud environments within approved monthly cost ceilings.

- 12+ years in distributed systems engineering with at least 4 years managing technical teams.
- Proven track record scaling microservices architectures in mission-critical environments.
